global: This tonkotsu broth, creamy beige and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with black rim, tender chashu pork and pale yellow menma sit beside a white ceramic spoon on a wooden table with warm brown grain.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with black rim and "Sugakiya" text, smooth surface, slightly chipped edge visible.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven surface texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
